transcriber_notes: SnowPilot fracture-line profile (no temperature axis, no temperatures). Height axis 3.807 px/cm (0 at y=1083); boundaries from bar outlines (+-0.5 cm), matching layer notes (159,157) and 'no data below 140cm'. Hardness axis ticks every 1/3 class; bar ends read on ticks. 7 table rows matched 1:1 to the bars 225-140; the 140-0 bar (P) has no table row and lies below the observed depth (profile_depth_cm = 225-140). Record id says 'nodate' but the chart prints 28/02/2021 12:32 (same date as the file name); avalanche date 2021-02-27 is in the notes. Size, moisture and density columns empty.
